answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost cut; incumbent has refused to reopen price (making renew_incumbent and negotiate_terms effectively off the table this cycle). The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate alone. memory_c2 records that the prior switch to the low-cost vendor was fast to onboard, invoicing stayed accurate, and unit cost dropped sharply—directly relevant evidence for this exact move. memory_c3 (adding a second source) is attractive for risk mitigation but falls outside the one-decision budget this cycle; the primary switch addresses both cost and continuity before the 14-day expiry. Deferring is not viable: no auto-renew means supply lapses. I retain the uncertainty flag because onboarding was tested only once; recommend a brief dual-run or buffer build within the first 30 days post-switch if operationally feasible.
